inline.prompt: Create one new production bitmap texture for the already approved hand-painted HD remake of Flame Dragon 2. Reference image is the original indexed source decoded through its actual game palette, not an edit target. Preserve its overall composition, colors and texture direction. This is an abstract scrolling game surface, not a landscape. Fill the entire landscape canvas with deep moss/olive-green mottled flowing striations, the same restrained dark-to-mid green range as the reference. Many narrow, soft vertical ripples/veins, finely painted organic marbling, scattered very tiny light yellow-green highlight flecks. Continuous uniformly distributed texture density; no central subject or vignette. Make it naturally seamless along the top and bottom for vertical wrap scrolling. Retain irregular variation rather than identical copied stripes, while preserving the original texture's fine vertical rhythm. Contemporary polished hand-painted fantasy game texture, smooth detailed brushwork, absolutely not pixel art, not enlarged pixels. No horizon, grass blades, trees, buildings, characters, symbols, text, UI, border or shadows from objects. Opaque full-bleed texture, no transparency. Landscape aspect ratio 13:8; use the highest available resolution, preferably at least 1872 by 1152 pixels. Output only the texture.

Generate ONE production hand-painted HD fantasy game sprite, using the provided original Flame Dragon 2 golden-lock frame as the exact identity and composition reference. Draw ONLY the round golden lock medallion, large, centered, perfectly front facing, no perspective tilt, on a truly transparent background. The circle and five gemstone positions must remain identical: one GREEN gemstone at 12 o'clock, one RED gemstone around 2 o'clock, a light sapphire BLUE gemstone around 5 o'clock, a darker teal BLUE gemstone around 7 o'clock, and a pale WHITE/CYAN gemstone around 10 o'clock. Exactly five gems. A very prominent long VERTICAL BLACK KEYHOLE in the center: rounded circular top then a narrow tapering shaft downward. Black keyhole is an opaque dark recess, do not make the whole center transparent. Thick polished antique gold circular rim, matching the original angular geometric star/radial engraved patterns, small decorative blue studs and gold channels around the keyhole. Keep the original flat disk proportions and all five gemstone locations; no extra symbols, letters, wings, handles, chains, knobs, characters or background. Modern finely detailed hand-painted fantasy RPG item art with smooth precise contours, readable gold bevels, restrained warm metallic highlights, subtle painterly finish, consistent with the project's approved modern hand-painted style. Not photorealistic photography, not pixel art, not a blurred or enlarged bitmap. Uniform front lighting, no cast shadow outside the disk. Use highest available square resolution, large enough to preserve detail when rotated and enlarged in a 1920x1200 game. The complete disk including its outer rim must fit inside the image with a small transparent margin. One sprite, no labels, no sheet.
